svg.text: power in L1 L2 L3 N PE, 5 × 7.5, top entry
power out L3 L2 L1 N, 4 × 7.5, top entry
For fit and installation only, not for manufacture.
1. Mount on the two Ø2.0 holes (M2 or self-tapping 2.2); keep Ø6 free around them on the top side.
2. Highest parts: power terminal blocks 24.2 mm and the power module 21.8 mm above the board.
3. Bottom side: through-hole solder joints, keep ≥3 mm free under the board (STEP keep-out); no bottom
4. All terminals top entry; leave ≥40 mm above the power terminals for wiring and the release tool.
5. Component boxes are envelopes from the board's 3D model (±0.5 mm); hole Ø and board thickness ≈.
